description.terminal: Reveal text on a terminal grid with typing, cursors and phosphor glow.
description.ink-bleed: Spread ink into paper fibers with irregular edges and absorption.
description.pixel-sort: Reorder pixels into streaks using brightness and color criteria.
description.edge-detect: Extract image or alpha contours using selectable edge detection methods.
description.window-trails: Repeat desktop windows in cascades and offset trails.
description.bevel: Light raised or recessed edges to create embossed relief.
description.displace: Distort the image with an input displacement map or procedural field.
description.thermal: Map image intensity to a thermal camera color palette.
description.time-warp-scan: Legacy scanline time distortion for saved projects.
description.morph: Inflate and stretch native shape geometry with staggered progress.
description.dither: Reduce tonal levels with a patterned distribution of pixels.
description.ascii: Rebuild the image from a customizable alphabet of text characters.
description.brightness: Lighten or darken the image by adjusting its overall brightness.
description.contrast: Increase or reduce the difference between bright and dark tones.
description.grayscale: Mix the image into monochrome black and white.
description.blur: Soften the image using Gaussian, box, directional, spin, zoom, lens bokeh or bilateral filtering, with an optional protected sharp region.
description.saturation: Adjust the overall intensity of image colors.
description.hue: Rotate colors around the hue wheel.
description.exposure: Adjust light intensity in photographic exposure stops.
description.vibrance: Boost muted colors while giving already saturated colors less emphasis.
description.temperature: Shift the white balance between cool blue and warm amber.
description.tint: Shift the white balance between green and magenta.
description.gamma: Adjust midtone brightness with a power curve.
description.invert: Reverse color channels into a photographic negative.
description.sepia: Tint the image with warm brown photographic tones.
description.threshold: Separate dark and bright pixels at an adjustable binary cutoff.
description.posterize: Reduce colors to discrete tonal steps and flat bands.
description.grain: Add fine or coarse film-like grain with a repeatable seed.
description.halftone: Classic print, separated circular dot grids and round color mosaics with rotation and transparent backgrounds.
description.vignette: Darken the outer corners around the image center.
description.gradient: Build procedural color fields, flowing gradients and patterned treatments.
description.ripple: Distort the image with concentric refractive waves around a movable center.
description.shatter: Break the image into displaced glass-like fragments.
description.noise: Generate seeded procedural fields, cellular textures and animated fractal clouds.
description.flashlight: Illuminate a movable circular or elliptical area with a soft falloff.
description.circle: Rebuild shading with a rotated grid of adjustable circular dots.
description.cyanotype: Create a blue photographic print with paper and exposure controls.
description.datamosh: Create a static compression-style treatment with displaced image blocks.
description.crt: Recreate a cathode-ray screen with scanlines, curvature and phosphor.
description.bit-dither: Combine a limited retro color palette with pixel dithering.
description.receipt: Print the image as a thermal paper receipt.
description.pink-phosphor: Recreate a pink phosphor display with luminous screen texture.
description.shadow: Cast an offset silhouette with adjustable softness, spread and color.
description.transition: Reveal or conceal the image with fades, wipes and other transition patterns.
description.liquify: Paint reversible round-brush deformations: push, pinch, inflate and twirl.
description.torn-edges: Create rough torn graphics or ragged paper silhouettes with controllable fibers and colors.
description.risograph: Print with two or three misregistered inks, dot screens, grain and textured paper.
description.oil-paint: Simplify image regions with a directional Kuwahara-style painterly filter and adjustable detail.
description.blocks: Build a source-colored toy-brick mosaic with raised circular studs, bevels and directional lighting.
description.chromatic-aberration: Separate red and blue channels radially or along an adjustable direction.
description.wind: Stretch source detail into directional streaks with seeded bands and animated gusts.
description.depth-of-field: Focus the composition using native camera depth, manual focus distance and aperture blur. Requires a 3D scene.
description.trail: Blend previous authored composition poses into temporal echoes, or repeat the current image with offsets.
